blocks.text: Millie Bobby Brown and her husband Jake Bongiovi are now a family of four as they welcomed another addition to their family through adoption. The couple have grown their family with the adoption of their second child, as confirmed by an unnamed source to PEOPLE on Thursday, Sept. 17. Brown seemingly confirmed this as well through a photo on her Instagram page showing her, Bongiovi and their first child’s hands alongside those of their newborn. “Hi little guy!” she said in the caption.
